The order was fulfilled and dispatched per our commerce platform (see evidence [0d325e75-02f7-576b-b55c-db2e07b95091]), with a tracking number assigned and confirmed as in-transit by ShipTrack PRO (see evidence [28f359ac-d5c4-5038-83f7-7224f62e1f40]). Although final delivery confirmation is pending due to a carrier data gap, all merchant obligations up to the point of dispatch have been met. We respectfully request the chargeback be reversed.
